title.zh: 时钟与角度 · 两根针的赛跑
title.en: Clocks & Angles · A Race Between Two Hands

description.zh: 时针 0.5°/分、分针 6°/分，由相对速度 5.5°/分算出夹角、重合与直角的时刻。仅限理想连续钟。
description.en: Hour hand 0.5°/min and minute hand 6°/min give a relative rate of 5.5°/min, from which angles, overlaps and right angles follow. Ideal continuous clock only.

reason.zh: 两根针都是绕圆心匀速转动，转过的角度与时间成正比，钟面就是一个带刻度的单位圆。
reason.en: Both hands turn about the centre at a constant rate, so angle is proportional to time and the dial is a graduated circle.

title.en: When do the clock hands overlap?
